description: Every US GLP-1 telehealth program GLP Chart rates, cheapest first, with its verified total monthly cost, its score and its lock-in terms. Filter by drug, US state or price ceiling.

drug.description: Restrict to programs that publish a price for one drug. One of: wegovy, zepbound, ozempic, mounjaro, rybelsus, sema_compounded, tirz_compounded, liraglutide. Plain names such as "compounded semaglutide" are accepted.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 10, maximum 50.

max_price.description: Only programs at or below this monthly figure, in USD.

state.description: Two-letter code or state name, e.g. "CA" or "California".

name: get_programs
title: List GLP-1 programs and prices
